usedFor: Dribbble holds shots and projects, and Memory keeps their details as key-value pairs through “Memory”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Shot Added” in Dribbble, then “Memory” in Memory
bestTemplate.why: Each new shot can be stored under a key, giving later runs something to look up.

watchOut: “New Shot Added” in Dribbble is polling, so Memory updates after a scheduled check.
